q1.a: Yes. The Free plan has no time limit and needs no card: up to 10 products, starter themes, cash on delivery and WhatsApp orders. A small Reelcart badge shows on your store.

q2.q: What does the $1 Pro month include?
q2.a: Everything in Pro for $1 your first month, then $15 a month, or $150 a year (2 months free). Pro gives you 100 products, all themes plus Theme Studio, 90-day analytics, discount codes and no Reelcart badge.

q3.a: Cash on delivery works on every plan. Pro adds online payment with FIB and ZainCash. FastPay and Qi Card are on the way.

q4.q: Do customers need an app or account?
q4.a: No. Shoppers open your link in any browser and order with their name, phone and address. No app, no sign-up. They can track the order later with the order number and phone.

q5.q: Can I use my own domain?
q5.a: Yes, on Business ($50 a month) and Max: connect a domain like shop.yourbrand.com. Free and Pro stores get their own Reelcart link.

q6.q: How does delivery pricing per city work?
q6.a: Your store starts with a delivery fee for every Iraqi governorate, from 3,000 IQD in Erbil. Change any fee, add towns or neighbourhoods with their own price, or offer free delivery over an amount. Shoppers see the fee for their city before they order.

q7.q: Can I sell in Kurdish and Arabic at once?
q7.a: Yes. Your store works in Sorani, Kurmanji, Arabic and English, right-to-left included, and shoppers switch with one tap. Write product names and descriptions in each language you want.

q8.q: How do I get paid, and can I cancel anytime?
q8.a: Cash orders are collected by your courier as usual. FIB and ZainCash orders are paid online and marked paid automatically. Plans are month to month: cancel anytime and your store and products stay exactly as they are.
